about: Fabricated and paraphrased evidence that must never verify (v1-e03-t04 ac5). Invented text only: every place, body and figure is made up. Each source's normalized text, every honest card's evidence and every expected offset was written by hand from the source, never produced by running the verifier or the normalizer. Offsets are code points. A fabrication claims its card's snapshot and offsets unless it says otherwise in `claims`. `first_differing_offset` is an index into the fabricated evidence text (evidence-text coordinates). Non-ASCII and invisible characters are written as \u escapes so they can be reviewed.

Its engineers put the risk of a breach at 1 in 40 — higher than the 1 in 100 standard.

sources.note: Paragraph one is 0-64 (64 code points; the à at 8, the curly quotes at 38 and 52, "not" at 44-47, "2031" at 59-63). The break is 64-66. Paragraph two is 66-152 (86 code points; within it "1 in 40" is 42-49, the em dash 50, "standard." 77-86). The no-break space in the extracted text normalizes to a space.
